title: 6.6 Finding Places in the Neighborhood
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Locate destinations using near, far from, between and across from, then make a useful travel choice.
grammar_function: Ana wants to find the library from the hotel. Luis first establishes which places are near and far, then pinpoints the library between two landmarks and across from the mall. Ana has enough information to walk to the correct building. Use one stable neighborhood with explicit wide and close views.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Locate destinations using near, far from, between and across from, then make a useful travel choice.
